units.text: ပြတင်းပေါက်တစ်ပေါက်လုံးကို မျက်လုံးတစ်လုံးက ဖုံးသွားတဲ့အချိန်မှာ ကျွန်မတို့ အိမ်အပြင် မထွက်သင့်တော့ဘူးလို့ ထင်ခဲ့တယ်။
မျက်လုံးက အညိုရောင်။ မျက်ဆံဘေးမှာ သွေးကြောသေးသေးတွေ မြင်ရတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 1 of 91 — "An Eye Filled the Window".

A single small windowpane, about an inch across, entirely filled by one human eye pressed against it from outside — brown iris, fine red capillaries in the white, ordinary lashes. The rest of the toy window frame and the tiny room are visible around it.

Detailed scene direction: Extreme interior close-up on ONE SMALL PANE about an inch wide, filled edge to edge by an ordinary brown human eye behind the glass — not a monster eye, and not a four-inch opening no real eye could cover. Keep the surrounding window bars and the miniature room edge visible as the scale anchor.

undefined

units.text: မျက်တောင်ခတ်လိုက်တိုင်း ပြတင်းပေါက်က တစ်ချက် မှောင်သွားတယ်။
ကိုဇင်က ကျွန်မပါးစပ်ကို ဖိပိတ်ပြီး နံရံအောက် ဆွဲချလိုက်တယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 2 of 91 — "The Room Went Dark When It Blinked".

Two people flattened beneath a window sill in a tiny room, a man's hand over the woman's mouth, the light across them cut by a slow blink.

Detailed scene direction: Floor-level medium-wide frame beneath the sill. May and Ko Zin are both four inches tall and pressed flat to the oversized wall; an eyelid crossing the pane above throws one hard band of shadow. CONTINUITY: this moment falls late in the story, so May's right calf is already bandaged with torn shirt cloth while Ko Zin's overshirt is still intact. He is protective, not violent.

undefined

units.text: အပြင်ကအရာက အိမ်ထဲကို ကြည့်နေတယ်။ ကျွန်မတို့ကို ရှာနေတာ။
အဲဒီအချိန်က ကျွန်မတို့ မသိသေးဘူး။

image_prompt:
Shot 3 of 91 — "It Was Looking For Us".

From inside the room, the eye fills the small window with its brown pupil angled downward, searching the interior; the hiding place below the sill remains outside its gaze.

Detailed scene direction: Compose from inside toward the window with the pupil angled downward as if searching. Keep May and Ko Zin fully concealed below the sill rather than showing anonymous extra people; communicate searching through gaze direction, not motion blur.

undefined

units.text: အပြင်ကမျက်လုံးက ကျွန်မတို့အတွက် အန္တရာယ်အကြီးဆုံးအရာ မဟုတ်ဘူး။
အိမ်ထဲမှာ ကျန်နေတဲ့အရာက ပိုမြန်တယ်။
ပြီးတော့ ကျွန်မတို့ ဘယ်နေရာမှာ ပုန်းနေလဲ သိတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 4 of 91 — "The Thing Inside Was Faster".

A dolls'-house staircase seen from the bottom, empty, leading up into shadow — the frame held on it a beat too long.

Detailed scene direction: Static low-angle view up the empty toy staircase, with huge wood grain, crude glue seams and an upper landing hidden by the turn. Use negative space and compressed framing for threat; no doll, person, night lighting or written text.

undefined

units.text: ကျွန်မနာမည် မေ။
ပရိဘောဂဟောင်းနဲ့ အလှဆင်ပစ္စည်းတွေ ပြန်ပြင်တဲ့အလုပ် လုပ်တယ်။
ကိုဇင်က ကျွန်မအစ်ကို။

image_prompt:
Shot 5 of 91 — "My Name Is May".

Careful hands working beeswax into the carved arm of an antique chair in a workshop, tools and rags laid out, daylight from a window.

Detailed scene direction: Three-quarter medium shot in May's practical furniture workshop, not the deceased woman's living room. Show May's recognizable face and uninjured full figure beside the chair, with wax cloth and hand tools secondary; her sage shirt and jeans remain clean and intact.

undefined

units.text: အဲဒီနေ့က အိမ်ဟောင်းတစ်လုံးမှာ ပစ္စည်းစာရင်းသွားယူကြတာ။
အိမ်ရှင်အဘွား ဆုံးသွားပြီ။ ကျန်တဲ့မိသားစုက ပစ္စည်းတွေထဲက တန်ဖိုးရှိတာကို ပြန်ပြင်ပြီး သိမ်းချင်တယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 6 of 91 — "Taking an Inventory".

A brother and sister moving through a crowded old living room with a clipboard and a phone camera, dust sheets half pulled back off furniture.

Detailed scene direction: Eye-level wide two-shot in the old living room. May photographs an object while Ko Zin writes on the clipboard; keep their faces readable, their clothes intact, and the display-case table visible deeper in the room as the next visual destination.

undefined

units.text: အခန်းအလယ်မှာတော့ မှန်အုပ်ထားတဲ့ စားပွဲကြီးတစ်လုံး ရှိတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 7 of 91 — "The Glass Case".

A large table in the centre of a cluttered room with a glass display case on it, the shape inside not yet clear through the reflections.

Detailed scene direction: Centered wide establishing shot with the display-case table isolated in the middle distance and clutter forming a frame around it. Reflections should obscure only the dolls' house details, not turn the case opaque or supernatural; no people required.

undefined

units.text: မှန်အောက်မှာ အိမ်တစ်လုံး။ အရုပ်အိမ်။
ကျွန်မ ရင်ဘတ်လောက်အမြင့် ရှိတယ်။ နှစ်ထပ်။
အပြာရောင်တံခါး။ အဖြူရောင်ပြတင်းပေါက်တွေ။
အတွင်းက ပရိဘောဂတွေကိုပါ အသေးစိတ် လုပ်ထားတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 8 of 91 — "A House Under Glass".

A beautifully made two-storey dolls' house under a glass case, chest height, with a blue front door and white window frames, fully furnished inside.

Detailed scene direction: Real-scale three-quarter product-like view of the complete chest-high dolls' house beneath clear glass. Show the blue door, white frames and furnished rooms together, with ordinary furniture around it proving that it is a miniature.

undefined

units.text: အိမ်ရှေ့ခန်းထဲမှာ ကလေးအရုပ်မတစ်ရုပ် ရှိတယ်။ အနီရောင်ဂါဝန်နဲ့။
မျက်နှာက ကြွေသား။ လည်ပင်းနည်းနည်း စောင်းနေတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 9 of 91 — "The Doll in the Front Room".

Looking into a dolls'-house front room through its window: a small porcelain-faced doll in a red dress standing in the middle of the floor, her head tilted a few degrees to one side.

Detailed scene direction: View through one front window at real scale. The red-dress doll stands small within the miniature room, full body visible, porcelain and jointed with the permanent neck tilt; do not make her human, decayed, oversized outside the house or damaged yet.

undefined

units.text: ကိုဇင်က မှန်အဖုံးကို မ တင်ကြည့်တယ်။ အရုပ်အိမ်ရဲ့ အပြာရောင်တံခါးက ပိတ်နေတယ်။
ကျွန်မက ခပ်သေးသေး ကြေးတံခါးခေါက်တံကို ထိလိုက်တယ်။
“အိမ်ရှင်ရှိလား” လို့ ရယ်ပြီး ပြောမိတယ်။ ကိုဇင်လည်း ရယ်တယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 10 of 91 — "Is Anyone Home".

A glass case lifted aside and a woman's fingertip reaching toward a tiny brass door knocker on a blue miniature door, both of them smiling.

Detailed scene direction: Medium-wide over-table composition: Ko Zin has already placed the glass cover safely aside while May leans in and touches the tiny brass knocker with one fingertip. Both recognizable faces share a relaxed smile; keep the blue miniature door and size difference clearly readable.

undefined

units.text: တံခါးခေါက်တံက တောက်။ လို့ မြည်တယ်။
အဲဒီအသံက အရုပ်အိမ်ထဲမှာ မြည်သင့်တဲ့အသံထက် အများကြီး ကျယ်တယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 11 of 91 — "Far Too Loud".

Extreme close-up of a tiny brass knocker falling against a miniature door, the whole frame on an object the size of a fingernail.

Detailed scene direction: True macro frame of brass knocker against blue painted wood, with fingertip-sized scale shown by thick paint and shallow focus. Freeze it at contact; do not attempt to visualize sound waves, vibration text or onomatopoeia.

undefined

units.text: ကျွန်မ မျက်စိတစ်ချက် ပြာသွားတယ်။ ကိုဇင်က ကျွန်မလက်ကို ဖမ်းတယ်။ “မေ?”
မှန်အုပ်လည်း မရှိတော့ဘူး။

image_prompt:
Shot 12 of 91 — "The Table Was Gone".

Two people standing in a small plain room, disoriented, no table or case anywhere — the proportions of the room subtly wrong, the floorboard grain far too wide.

Detailed scene direction: Wide full-body two-shot immediately after transformation. May and Ko Zin are exactly four inches tall, dwarfed by floorboard grain as wide as paving slabs and toy furniture looming around them; both are uninjured and Ko Zin's shirt is intact. The missing real table and glass case must leave obvious empty space.

undefined

units.text: အပြာရောင်တံခါးက ကျွန်မတို့နောက်မှာ ရောက်နေတယ်။ ကျွန်မတို့ထက် အဆများစွာ မြင့်နေတယ်။ လက်ကိုင်က ခေါင်းထိပ်လောက်မှာ။

image_prompt:
Shot 13 of 91 — "The Blue Door Was Behind Us".

Low-angle wide shot inside the dolls' house: four-inch-tall May and Ko Zin stand full-body in the foreground and the blue-painted door behind them TOWERS over them — its handle sits at about the top of their heads, touchable at full stretch and far too thick to grip. Thick brush strokes, rounded toy edges and oversized wood grain expose it as a handmade miniature.

Detailed scene direction: Extreme low angle. Keep both characters full-body and small in the lower third while the blue toy door dominates the frame; its handle sits at about the top of their heads, reachable at full stretch but far too big to grip. May and Ko Zin have intact clothes and May's right calf is unhurt at this point; no full-size humans, doll, glass case or ordinary-sized modern door.

undefined

units.text: အစမှာ ကျွန်မတို့ အရင်အိမ်ရဲ့ တခြားအခန်းတစ်ခန်းထဲ ရောက်သွားတာလို့ ထင်မိတယ်။
ကိုဇင်က လက်ကိုင်ကို လှမ်းကိုင်ဖို့ ကြိုးစားတယ်။ မရဘူး။ လက်ကိုင်က ခေါင်းထက် အများကြီး အထက်မှာ။ တံခါးအောက်ပိုင်းကို တွန်းကြည့်တယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 14 of 91 — "We Tried to Believe Otherwise".

A four-inch-tall man with both hands flat on the lower panel of a door many times his height, shoving with his whole body. ⚠️ THE HANDLE IS LEVEL WITH THE TOP OF HIS HEAD — he has already stretched to it and could not close a hand around it, so he is using the panel instead.

Detailed scene direction: Side-angle medium full-body shot of intact-shirt Ko Zin with both palms flat on the lower panel of the toy door, shoulder and one braced foot behind the shove. He has ALREADY tried the handle and failed: it is level with the top of his head, far too thick for his hand to close around, and it does not turn. The blue door stays perfectly flush. Oversized brush texture and floor grain preserve four-inch scale.

undefined

units.text: ကျွန်မက ပြတင်းပေါက်ကို သွားကြည့်တယ်။
အပြင်မှာ အဖြူရောင်အလင်းပဲ ရှိတယ်။ လမ်းမမြင်ရဘူး။ ခြံမမြင်ရဘူး။ သစ်ပင်မမြင်ရဘူး။

image_prompt:
Shot 15 of 91 — "Only White Light Outside".

A window from inside showing nothing beyond it but a flat featureless white glow — no sky, no ground, no depth at all.

Detailed scene direction: Over-May's-shoulder view toward the sealed miniature window. Her uninjured silhouette occupies one edge while perfectly flat white light fills the glass with no horizon, scenery or eye; the painted toy frame and giant grain remain sharp.

undefined

units.text: ပြတင်းပေါက်အောက်ခြေကို လက်နဲ့ စမ်းကြည့်လိုက်တယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 16 of 91 — "The Handle Was Painted On".

Extreme close-up of a window catch that is not a catch — a handle shape painted flat onto the timber in thick brush strokes, brush hairs visible in the paint.

Detailed scene direction: Extreme macro of the false catch with raking daylight revealing raised brush strokes and trapped brush hairs. It must be a flat painted illusion with no projecting metal hardware, hand, text or readable symbol.

undefined

units.text: ကျွန်မ အစ်ကို့ကို လှည့်ကြည့်လိုက်တယ်။ သူက တံခါးကို ပခုံးနဲ့ ဆောင့်နေတယ်။
အပေါ်ထပ်ကနေ ဒုန်း။ လို့ ပြန်မြည်လာတယ်။
နှစ်ယောက်လုံး ရပ်လိုက်ကြတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 17 of 91 — "Something Knocked Back".

A four-inch-tall man mid-impact with his shoulder against the very bottom of an enormous door, and far above him a ceiling with dust jarred loose from it by something answering from the floor above.

Detailed scene direction: Low three-quarter action frame of intact-shirt Ko Zin driving his shoulder into the very bottom of the enormous door as two separate puffs of oversized dust fall from the ceiling far above him. Freeze the impact cleanly; no visible upstairs figure, doll or supernatural glow.

undefined

units.text: အပေါ်က ခြေသံနှစ်ချက် ထွက်လာတယ်။
လူ့ခြေသံထက် လေးတယ်။ သစ်သားတုံးတစ်တုံးကို ကြမ်းပြင်ပေါ် ထောင်ချနေသလို။

image_prompt:
Shot 18 of 91 — "Heavier Than a Person".

A plain dolls'-house ceiling seen from below, dust sifting down through light in two separate falls where two impacts have landed.

Detailed scene direction: Upward-looking ceiling close-up with two distinct dust falls landing in sequence across different joints. Use scale through coarse timber and large dust particles; show no feet, creature, text or night darkness.

undefined

units.text: ပြီးတော့ မိန်းကလေးအသံတစ်ခု ကြားရတယ်။ “ရောက်လာပြီလား…”
အသံက လူပြောသလို မဆက်ဘူး။ စကားတစ်ပိုင်းချင်းကြားမှာ စက်လည်သံလေး ပါနေတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 19 of 91 — "Have You Come".

An empty dolls'-house stairwell from below, the top of it lost in shadow, nothing visible on the steps.

Detailed scene direction: Centered view up the empty staircase with the top landing occluded, not black. Preserve flat afternoon spill light below and let the unanswered empty space carry the voice; no doll hem or person yet.

undefined

units.text: ကိုဇင်က ကျွန်မကို စားပွဲအောက် ဆွဲခေါ်တယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 20 of 91 — "Under the Table".

Four-inch-tall May and Ko Zin crouched beneath a dolls'-house dining table that now looms over them like full-sized furniture, its underside exposing enormous crude glue joints and unfinished timber.

Detailed scene direction: Ground-level wide shot beneath a dolls'-house dining table that now looms like full-sized furniture over four-inch May and Ko Zin. Show both crouched close together, uninjured, beneath crude giant glue joints; never describe or render the table as tiny relative to them.

undefined

units.text: လှေကားကနေ အရိပ်ကြီးတစ်ခု ဆင်းလာတယ်။
အရင်ဆုံး အနီရောင်ဂါဝန်အနားကို မြင်ရတယ်။ ပြီးတော့ ခြေထောက်တွေ။

image_prompt:
Shot 21 of 91 — "A Red Hem on the Stairs".

From under a table: the hem of an enormous red dress descending a staircase, only the fabric and the bottom steps in frame.

Detailed scene direction: May-and-Ko-Zin viewpoint from under the table: only the enormous crimson hem, bare porcelain foot and lower rigid leg descend into view. Keep the hidden people off-camera, the doll visibly toy-made and undamaged, and the scale at more than twice their height.

undefined

units.text: ဖြူဖွေးနေတယ်။ ဒူးတွေမှာ စက်ဝိုင်းပုံ အဆက်တွေ ရှိတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 22 of 91 — "Ball Joints at the Knees".

⚠️ HER STIFFNESS IS HER JOINTS, NOT THE STAIRS — the treads fit her perfectly and she still swings each leg from the hip because the knees do not bend. A doll's legs at enormous scale: smooth white porcelain with a clearly moulded spherical ball joint at each knee, the seam line around it visible.

Detailed scene direction: Clinical side macro on both porcelain knees, spherical joints and mould seams in crisp focus, red skirt hem above. IMPORTANT: the stair treads fit her perfectly — her stiffness is the joint, not the staircase, so show a comfortable tread under a straight rigid leg. No flesh, skin pores, wounds, blood or human kneecaps.

undefined

units.text: လှေကားတစ်ထစ် ဆင်းတိုင်း ခြေထောက်တစ်ဖက်လုံးကို ကားမြှောက်ပြီး ချတယ်။
ကျွန်မတို့ စားပွဲအောက်မှာ အသက်မရှူရဲဘူး။

image_prompt:
Shot 23 of 91 — "She Did Not Bend Them".

A doll descending a stair with one whole rigid leg swung out from the hip and set down flat, the knee joint not flexing at all.

Detailed scene direction: Profile full-leg action frame: the doll advances by swinging one rigid leg from the hip while the spherical knee remains locked straight. Keep porcelain seams and toy stiffness obvious; no natural human walking pose.

undefined

units.text: သူ့ခြေထောက်တစ်ဖက်က စားပွဲနားမှာ လာရပ်တယ်။ ဖိနပ်မပါဘူး။
ခြေဖဝါးအလယ်မှာ စာလုံးတချို့ ထုထားတယ်။ ကျွန်မ သေချာမဖတ်နိုင်ဘူး။

image_prompt:
Shot 24 of 91 — "Marks Stamped in the Sole".

The sole of a huge bare porcelain foot beside a table leg, with maker's marks pressed into the glaze — shapes that read as stamped lettering but are not legible.

Detailed scene direction: Under-table close-up with the huge porcelain sole stopped beside an oversized table leg. Angle the foot so pressed maker's marks are visible as abstract indentations but impossible to read; preserve the same doll's red hem and undamaged toy material.

undefined

units.text: အဲဒီနောက် သူ ဒူးမကွေးဘဲ ခါးကနေ ရှေ့ကို ခေါက်ကျလာတယ်။
ကြွေမျက်နှာကြီးက စားပွဲအောက်ကို ဝင်လာတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 25 of 91 — "She Folded at the Waist".

A doll bent forward from the waist alone with both legs perfectly straight, her large porcelain face coming in under a table edge upside down.

Detailed scene direction: Low point-of-view from the hiding place as the doll hinges only at the waist and places her upside-down porcelain face beneath the table edge. Both legs remain ruler-straight; no flexible spine, hair obscuring the toy face, flesh or gore.

undefined

units.text: မျက်လုံးနှစ်လုံးက တစ်ပြိုင်နက် မရွေ့ဘူး။
တစ်လုံးက ကျွန်မကို ကြည့်တယ်။ နောက်တစ်လုံးက ခဏနောက်ကျပြီးမှ လိုက်လာတယ်။

A full-size woman looking down at her own calf and finding it unmarked, while on the cloth beside her a tiny version of herself has a bound and bleeding leg.

units.text: နှစ်ယောက်စလုံး ကျွန်မနာမည်ကို ခေါ်တတ်တယ်။ နှစ်ယောက်စလုံး ကျွန်မတို့အမေ့နာမည် သိတယ်။
အပြင်ကအမျိုးသမီးက ကျွန်မကို မေးတယ်။ “နင်… ဒီမနက် ဘာစားခဲ့လဲ”
ကျွန်မ ပြန်ဖြေတယ်။ သူ့မျက်နှာမှာ အရောင်ပျောက်သွားတယ်။ တူတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 75 of 91 — "What Did You Eat This Morning".

A full-size woman's face draining of colour as she listens to an answer she already knew.

Detailed scene direction: Over-tiny-May's-shoulder shot toward full-size May as recognition drains the color from her face. Include enough of tiny May's matching profile and giant cloth weave to establish the two scales; expressions should mirror rather than become theatrical.

units.text: မနက်က ကိုဇင်နဲ့ ဘာစကားများခဲ့လဲ။ အိမ်ကထွက်လာတုန်း ဘယ်သူ ဖုန်းဆက်ခဲ့လဲ။
ကျွန်မဘယ်သူ့ကိုမှ မပြောဖူးတဲ့ အမေ့ဆေးဖိုးအကြောင်း။ အကုန် သိတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 76 of 91 — "She Knew About the Medicine Money".

Two women's faces at wildly different scales in one frame, looking at each other with the same expression.

Detailed scene direction: Balanced profile two-shot with tiny injured May on the cloth facing full-size uninjured May at eye level across the scale gap. Their faces and expressions must be identical, with the private shared memory conveyed through recognition only; no text or medicine imagery.

undefined

units.text: အဲဒီအရုပ်အိမ်တံခါးကို ခေါက်လိုက်တဲ့အချိန်အထိ ကျွန်မတို့နှစ်ယောက်ရဲ့ မှတ်ဉာဏ်တွေ အတူတူ။
အဲဒီနောက်ကစပြီး ကွဲသွားတာ။

image_prompt:
Shot 77 of 91 — "We Diverged at the Knock".

The tiny brass knocker on the blue miniature door again, still, in flat daylight — the exact point everything forked.

Detailed scene direction: Macro callback to the same brass knocker and blue miniature door in flat daylight. Keep it perfectly still and visually identical to shot 11, but without a fingertip; no split screen, timeline graphic, text or supernatural glow.

units.text: အပြင်က ကျွန်မတို့နှစ်ယောက်က အရုပ်အိမ်ကို စစ်ကြည့်ပြီး နောက်အခန်းကပစ္စည်းတွေ သွားကြည့်ခဲ့ကြတယ်။
ရေသောက်တယ်။ အလုပ်အကြောင်း ဖုန်းပြောတယ်။ ပစ္စည်းစာရင်း ရေးတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 78 of 91 — "They Never Stopped Working".

Two people at ordinary scale moving calmly through an old house with a clipboard, one on the phone, one drinking water — an entirely unremarkable working afternoon.

Detailed scene direction: Natural observational wide shot of full-size May and full-size Ko Zin continuing inventory work in another part of the old house. Both clothes are intact, they act calm and ordinary, and no tiny people or doll are visible.

undefined

units.text: အဲဒီအချိန်တစ်လျှောက်လုံး ကျွန်မတို့က အိမ်သေးသေးထဲမှာ ပြေးနေရတယ်။
အရုပ်တစ်ရုပ်ရဲ့လက်ထဲ မပါသွားအောင်။

image_prompt:
Shot 79 of 91 — "While We Were Running".

Wide real-scale view of the quiet dolls' house on its table in the sunlit living room. Through one lit upstairs WINDOW, tiny May and Ko Zin are visible mid-flight across a miniature room while the full-size pair go about their inventory elsewhere in the room, entirely unaware.

Detailed scene direction: Keep the dolls' house CLOSED — read the interior through a window, never through a removed wall, or the audience will ask why they do not climb out of the opening. The surrounding room is tranquil. CONTINUITY: this summarises the whole ordeal rather than its last seconds, so Ko Zin's shirt is still INTACT and the doll's hand is still UNCHIPPED; only May's calf is bandaged. Keep all figures readable but small.

units.text: မနက်က ကျွန်မတို့ရှေ့က စားပွဲ ပျောက်သွားတာ မဟုတ်ဘူး။
စားပွဲရှေ့မှာ ရပ်နေတဲ့ ကျွန်မတို့က အဲဒီနေရာမှာ ဆက်ရှိနေခဲ့တယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 80 of 91 — "The Table Never Vanished".

The table with the dolls' house on it, two people standing at it exactly as before, nothing out of the ordinary at all.

Detailed scene direction: Recreate the pre-transformation table composition at real scale with full-size uninjured May and intact-shirt Ko Zin standing normally beside the dolls' house. Everything is ordinary and continuous; no tiny originals are visible outside the house.

units.text: အရုပ်အိမ်ထဲမှာ နောက်ထပ် ကျွန်မတို့နှစ်ယောက် စဖြစ်လာတာ။

image_prompt:
Shot 81 of 91 — "Another Two of Us Began".

Looking through the front window of the dolls' house: miniature, newly formed copies of May and Ko Zin stand together in the front room where no people stood before. Their faces, intact clothes and hair exactly match the full-size duplicates outside; the red-dress doll is absent.

Detailed scene direction: Frame through the dolls'-house window at real scale, with the newly formed tiny copies centered and recognizable as uninjured May and intact-shirt Ko Zin. They should look newly present and still, not translucent, ghostly, doll-like or wounded.

units.text: အပြင်က ကိုဇင်က အရုပ်အိမ်တံခါးပေါင်အောက်မှာ စာသေးသေးတစ်ကြောင်း တွေ့တယ်။
ခပ်ဟောင်းဟောင်း လက်ရေးနဲ့။

units.text: အိမ်ရှင်အဘွား ငယ်ငယ်ကပုံကိုလည်း စာအုပ်တစ်အုပ်ထဲမှာ တွေ့တယ်။
အနီရောင်ဂါဝန်နဲ့ ကလေးအရုပ်ကို ပိုက်ထားတဲ့ ကောင်မလေး။
အရုပ်ရဲ့ လည်ပင်းက အဲဒီဓာတ်ပုံထဲမှာလည်း နည်းနည်း စောင်းနေတယ်။

An old black-and-white photograph filling the frame: a small Burmese girl holds the same porcelain doll close to her chest. The doll's crimson-red dress reads as dark gray in the old photograph, and her neck is already tilted at exactly the same angle.

units.text: အပြင်က ကိုဇင်က အရုပ်ကို သေတ္တာတစ်လုံးထဲ ထည့်ပိတ်ထားတယ်။
အတွင်းကနေ ကြွေသားနဲ့ သစ်သားထိသံ ခဏခဏ ကြားရတယ်။
တစ်ခါတလေ “အိမ်ထဲမှာ လူရှိရမယ်” ဆိုတဲ့စကား ကြားရတယ်။
ကျွန်မတို့ကတော့ အဲဒီဘက်ကို မကြည့်တော့ဘူး။

A wooden crate closed and latched on a floor in daylight, ordinary and unremarkable, photographed dead-on and held.

Detailed scene direction: Dead-center locked composition of a plain wooden crate with lid fully closed and metal latch secured in the old living room. Keep it inert in daylight; no doll part, movement line, face, text, blood or ominous supernatural glow.

units.text: အပြင်က ကျွန်မက ကျွန်မတို့ကို အိမ်ခေါ်သွားတယ်။
ရေကို အဖုံးသေးသေးတစ်ခုထဲ ထည့်ပေးတယ်။

Two tiny people nested in folded cloth inside a shallow box on a car seat, a seatbelt drawn across the box, daylight through the window.

Detailed scene direction: Car-seat-level medium-wide shot. Injured May and torn-shirt Ko Zin are exactly four inches tall, safely nested in cloth inside the shallow box; giant seat upholstery, belt buckle and bottle-cap-sized water dish prove scale. No old-house objects or full-size person in frame.

units.text: သူက ကျွန်မနာတဲ့အခါ မျက်ရည်ကျတယ်။ ကျွန်မလည်း သူ့ကို မုန်းလို့မရဘူး။
သူက ကျွန်မပဲ။ တစ်ချိန်တည်းမှာ ကျွန်မ မဟုတ်တော့ဘူး။

image_prompt:

Inside a parked car at tabletop height on the passenger seat: full-size May bends close with tears on her kind face while carefully adjusting the cloth dressing on tiny May's right calf. Tiny May lies on folded soft cloth with a bottle cap of water beside her.

Detailed scene direction: Set this IN THE CAR, not at the house — it happens on the drive home, before the mother is heard. Focus on the two identical May faces at radically different scales, with the dressing and the bottle-cap water secondary. Full-size May is openly compassionate, tiny May exhausted but receptive, the interior warm rather than frightening.

units.text: အိမ်ပြန်ရောက်တော့ အမေ့အသံ ကြားရတယ်။ “မေ၊ ပြန်လာပြီလား”
ကျွန်မ ချက်ချင်း ထမိတယ်။ “အမေ…” လို့ ပြန်ထူးမိတယ်။
ကျွန်မအသံကို အမေ မကြားဘူး။

A tiny woman standing bolt upright in a box on a table, turned toward a doorway, one hand raised — utterly unheard.

Detailed scene direction: Low tabletop medium shot of tiny injured May springing upright in the box and reaching toward the enormous home doorway. Her mouth is open in reply and the distant older woman remains only a soft silhouette; no one turns toward tiny May.

units.text: အပြင်က ကျွန်မက “ပြန်လာပြီ အမေ” လို့ ဖြေတယ်။
အမေက သူ့လက်ထဲကအိတ်ကို ယူပေးတယ်။ နောက်ကျလို့ ပင်ပန်းနေပြီလားလို့ မေးတယ်။

image_prompt:
Shot 88 of 91 — "The Other One Answered".

From table height: a full-size woman walking away toward an older woman in a doorway, the two of them embracing, seen past the blurred edge of a box.

Detailed scene direction: From the same low tabletop axis, show full-size May walking to her ordinary older mother, who TAKES THE BAG OUT OF HER HAND before a warm embrace — the older woman is the one doing the carrying. The blurred box edge anchors tiny May's viewpoint; both women are natural and unaware, never sinister.

units.text: ကျွန်မ ဘာမှမပြောနိုင်ဘူး။
ကျွန်မတို့ ရုန်းကန်လွတ်မြောက်ခဲ့တဲ့ အပြင်လောကက ဒီအတိုင်းပဲ ဆက်လည်ပတ်နေတယ်။
ဘယ်သူမှ ကျွန်မကို မပျောက်ဘူး။ ဘယ်သူမှ ကျွန်မကို လိုက်မရှာခဲ့ဘူး။

image_prompt:
Shot 89 of 91 — "Nobody Had Lost Me".

From tiny May's tabletop viewpoint, her small shoulder and bandaged leg are soft in the near foreground while the family continues an ordinary warm evening across the enormous room. Full-size May belongs naturally among them; nobody looks toward or searches for tiny May.

Detailed scene direction: Use deep spatial separation: tiny injured May isolated at the near table edge while full-size May participates in the family group far across the warm room. The family is not cruel; their normal ease and failure to search create the tragedy.

units.text: ကျွန်မ ပြန်သွားချင်ခဲ့တဲ့ အိမ်မှာ ကျွန်မ ရှိနေပြီးသား။
ကျွန်မဖက်ချင်ခဲ့တဲ့ အမေ့ကိုလည်း ကျွန်မတစ်ယောက်က ဖက်ထားပြီးသား။
စားပွဲပေါ်ကနေ ကျွန်မ အမေ့ကို လက်လှမ်းလိုက်မိတယ်။ လက်က မမီဘူး။

image_prompt:
Shot 90 of 91 — "Someone Is Already Holding Her".

A tiny figure at the edge of a table with one arm outstretched toward two women embracing across the room, far out of reach and out of focus.

Detailed scene direction: Tight foreground on tiny injured May reaching from the table edge, with her small hand sharp and the distant embrace between full-size May and her mother recognizable but soft. Maintain the exact duplicate face and sage shirt; no impossible stretched arm or eye contact.

undefined

units.text: ဘေးမှာထိုင်နေတဲ့ ကိုဇင်က ကျွန်မလက်ကို ဖမ်းထားလိုက်တယ်။
အဲဒီအချိန်မှ အနီရောင်အရုပ် နောက်ဆုံးပြောခဲ့တဲ့စကားကို ကျွန်မ နားလည်သွားတယ်။
အပြင်မှာ ကျွန်မတို့အတွက် နေရာမရှိဘူး။

image_prompt:
Shot 91 of 91 — "Because We Are Already There".

Final composition: two tiny people on a tabletop, one holding the other's outstretched hand and drawing it gently back, the warm lit room beyond them soft and enormous. Hold on the two of them.

Detailed scene direction: Final low tabletop wide shot: torn-shirt Ko Zin sits beside injured May and gently draws her reaching hand back into his. Keep both tiny figures sharp against the immense warm family room fading softly behind them; quiet resignation, no doll, no full-size duplicate foreground and no horror effect.
